EntropyOS

2022
Video installation (non-durational, software-generated audiovisual environment)

EntropyOS is a live simulation set on a computer desktop, in which random numbers drive the narrative. Randomness is the raw material of encryption, and the piece treats it as a resource with a political economy of its own. Built in real time, with a generative soundscape by Ron Shalom, it has no fixed duration and never plays the same way twice.
